problems.title: Find a coefficient from two roots
problems.question: The roots of ax²+bx+1=0 are -2 and 5. Find b.
problems.idea: Use the product to find a, then the root sum.

problems.title: A section creating similar trapezoids
problems.question: A trapezoid has bases a,b. Find a parallel section dividing it into two similar trapezoids.
problems.idea: Match the successive bases under the intended correspondence.
formulas: Similar trapezoids have proportional corresponding bases.
steps: Let the section length be x. The smaller trapezoid has bases a,x and the larger has x,b.
Thus x²=ab and the positive length is √(ab).
problems.note: This is the standard correspondence in which the parallel bases match in order. It assumes the stated similar partition exists; arbitrary trapezoids need not admit it.

problems.title: An angle-bisecting diagonal in an isosceles trapezoid
problems.question: An isosceles trapezoid’s large base is 1.5 times its small base. A diagonal bisects an acute angle. Find the sine of that angle.
problems.idea: The bisector condition makes a leg equal to the small base.
formulas: Equal triangle angles give equal opposite sides; cosθ=horizontal leg projection/leg.
steps: Let the small base be b and the large base 3b/2.
The bisector and parallel bases create an isosceles triangle showing each leg is b.
The horizontal projection of a leg is half the base difference, b/4. Thus cosθ=(b/4)/b=1/4.

problems.title: Convert an integer to binary
problems.question: Write 199 in base two.
problems.idea: Express the number as a sum of powers of two.
steps: From 128 down to 1, the coefficients are 1,1,0,0,0,1,1,1.

problems.title: Minimum similar-triangle perimeter from a side difference
problems.question: A triangle has sides 7,10,12. A similar triangle has two sides differing by 10 cm. Find its least possible perimeter.
problems.idea: The largest original side difference requires the smallest similarity scale.
formulas: A similarity factor k multiplies both side differences and perimeter by k.
steps: To make one difference 10, the scale factors are 10/3,5,2. The smallest is 2.
The original perimeter is 29, so the minimum new perimeter is 2·29=58.

problems.title: More than two roots force a zero polynomial
problems.question: For which a does (a²-6a+8)x²+(a²-4)x+10-3a-a²=0 have more than two real solutions?
problems.idea: A polynomial of degree at most two needs all coefficients zero to have more than two roots.
formulas: A nonzero polynomial of degree n has at most n distinct roots.
steps: The leading coefficient is (a-2)(a-4), so a is 2 or 4.
The x-coefficient a²-4 vanishes at a=±2. Only a=2 is shared.
At a=2 the constant is 10-6-4=0 as well.
The equation becomes 0=0, true for every real x.

problems.title: Distance between a parabola and line’s intersection points
problems.question: The graphs y=x²+4x-6 and y=2x+2 meet at A,B. Find AB.
problems.idea: Solve for the intersection inputs, then use the distance formula.
problems.note: This is the second question printed as number 7. The earlier number 7 is retained separately as Problem 26.

problems.title: A lower bound rules out a radical equation
problems.question: Solve $\sqrt{5-x}+\sqrt{x^2+4}=2$.
problems.idea: One radical is already at least 2.
formulas: √(x²+4)≥2, with equality only at x=0; a square root is nonnegative.
steps: For the sum to be 2, we would need both √(x²+4)=2 and √(5-x)=0.
The first requires x=0 and the second x=5, which cannot happen together.
problems.note: This is the second question printed as number 8. The earlier number 8 is retained separately as Problem 27.

problems.title: Match coefficients in a factorization
problems.question: If 3x²+2kx+10=(x+2)(3x+3c), find k.
problems.idea: Expand the product and compare coefficients.
formulas: Identical polynomials have equal coefficients of every power.
steps: The constant equation is 6c=10, so c=5/3.

problems.title: Two sides from the parallelogram law
problems.question: A parallelogram has diagonals 6 and 12, and its sides differ by 1. Find the perimeter.
problems.idea: Use the sum of squared sides and then their sum.
steps: The positive side sum is √179, so the perimeter is 2√179.
problems.answer: $2\sqrt{179}$; none of the listed numerical choices.

problems.title: A tangent line fixes the squared radius
problems.question: For which a is y+3=x tangent to (x+1)²+(y+2)²=a?
problems.idea: Tangency means the centre-to-line distance equals the radius.
steps: The centre is (-1,-2) and the line is x-y-3=0.
The radius squared is a, so a=(√2)²=2.

problems.title: Mean relative to a median of three values
problems.question: For three data values, the median exceeds the smallest by 5 and is 9 less than the largest. By how much does their mean exceed the median?
problems.idea: Write all values relative to the median.
steps: If the median is m, the values are m-5,m,m+9.
The excess over the median is 4/3.

problems.title: Diagonal of an isosceles trapezoid
problems.question: An isosceles trapezoid has midline 15 and height 8. Find its diagonal.
problems.idea: The diagonal’s horizontal projection equals the midline.
steps: By symmetry, a diagonal crosses half the sum of the two bases horizontally, which is 15.

problems.title: A quadratic from two radical roots
problems.question: Find a quadratic equation with roots $(1-\sqrt5)/4$ and $(1+\sqrt5)/4$.
problems.idea: Use the root sum and product.
formulas: A monic quadratic with roots r,s is x²-(r+s)x+rs=0.

problems.title: Join the midpoints of a rectangle’s sides
problems.question: A rectangle has sides 3 and 5 cm. Find the perimeter of the quadrilateral joining its side midpoints.
problems.idea: Each new side is half a rectangle diagonal.
formulas: A triangle’s midpoint segment is half its third side; diagonal=√(3²+5²).

problems.title: Reflect a point across a slanted line
problems.question: Find the reflection of P(-2,2) in x+3y-6=0.
problems.idea: Move twice the perpendicular displacement from P to the line.
formulas: For Ax+By+C=0, set d=(Ax₀+By₀+C)/(A²+B²); reflected point=(x₀-2Ad,y₀-2Bd).

problems.title: Circle from a diameter’s endpoints
problems.question: Write the circle equation with diameter endpoints A(4,5),B(-2,1).
problems.idea: Its centre is the midpoint and its radius is half the diameter.
steps: The diameter squared is 6²+4²=52, so R²=13.

problems.title: Use the sine rule for a pair of sides
problems.question: In ABC, A=30°,B=45°, and AC+BC=18(1+√2). Find BC.
problems.idea: The side ratio equals the sine ratio of the opposite angles.
steps: Divide by the positive common factor to obtain BC=18.

problems.title: Square two nonnegative absolute values
problems.question: Solve |2x-1|<|x|.
problems.idea: Both sides are nonnegative, so squaring is equivalent.
steps: The product is negative strictly between its two roots.

problems.title: Two circles tangent to both axes through one point
problems.question: Find every circle tangent to both coordinate axes and passing through (1,2).
problems.idea: A circle tangent to both axes and containing a first-quadrant point must have centre (r,r), r>0.
steps: For r=1, the centre is (1,1); for r=5 it is (5,5). Both circles pass through (1,2).
problems.note: The printed choices include only the first circle. The conditions allow both.

problems.title: Centroid coordinates are vertex averages
problems.question: Find the intersection of the medians of A(1,4),B(-5,0),C(-2,-1).
problems.idea: The median intersection is the centroid.

problems.title: Add binary numbers using decimal place values
problems.question: Calculate $1110_2+101_2$.
problems.idea: Convert or add directly with binary carrying.

problems.title: Simplify radicals before multiplying
problems.question: Evaluate $(0.5\sqrt{24}-3\sqrt{40})(\sqrt{150}-\sqrt{54}-\sqrt{1000})$.
problems.idea: Extract square factors in every radical.

problems.title: Intersect two lower-bound inequalities
problems.question: Solve $(2x-1)/4-(x-3)/3<(3x-1)/6+1$, $(5x+6)/2-2x<(3x-7)/3+4$.
problems.idea: Clear denominators and intersect.
steps: Multiply the first by 12: 6x-3-4x+12<6x-2+12, giving x>-1/4.
Multiply the second by 6: 15x+18-12x<6x-14+24, giving 8<3x and x>8/3.

problems.title: Reduce a trigonometric fraction to a tangent
problems.question: Find $(1-\sin^4\alpha-\cos^4\alpha)/\cos^4\alpha$ if tanα=2.
problems.idea: Square sin²α+cos²α=1 to find the numerator.
steps: Divide by cos⁴α, which is nonzero because tanα is defined.

problems.title: Absolute-value inputs keep only positive roots
problems.question: f(x)=0 has five distinct roots, three positive and two negative. How many roots has f(|x|)=0?
problems.idea: The input |x| cannot be negative.
formulas: For r>0, |x|=r has exactly two roots x=±r.
steps: Neither negative root of f can equal |x|.
Each of the three positive roots gives two x-values.
There is no zero root among the stated five, so the total is 3·2=6.
problems.note: This is the first question printed as number 7. It was previously merged into the extracted Problem 06. It is preserved as supplementary Problem 26 to keep the existing later numbering stable.

problems.title: The denominator forces a negative parameter
problems.question: Solve $(2|a|^3+a^3)/(|a|^3-a^3)=0.5$.
problems.idea: Check where the denominator is nonzero before simplifying.
steps: If a≥0, the denominator is zero, so those values are outside the domain.
If a<0, the numerator is -2a³+a³=-a³ and the denominator is -a³-a³=-2a³.
Their quotient is 1/2 for every negative a.
problems.note: This is the first question printed as number 8. It was previously merged into the extracted Problem 06. It is preserved as supplementary Problem 27 to keep the existing later numbering stable.
